name: RRT 98% Validation Framework
principle: 98% is not a single vague accuracy number. It is decomposed into independently measurable reliability metrics.

M1_claim_attribution_accuracy.unit: material factual claims correctly supported by cited evidence

M2_entity_integrity.unit: evidence assigned to correct prospect/competitor entity

M3_saturation_gate_precision.unit: cases allowed downstream that pass independent saturation audit

M4_false_signal_rate.unit: approved Opportunity Signals rejected by independent blind review

validation_stages.purpose: estimate error modes and tune gates
measure reliability with blinded independent review

hard_rule: The project may not claim '98% accurate' until the named metric reaches its target on the Validation sample, with denominator and adjudication method reported.
